answer: One defence is Proof of unique gene sequencing run ID: runs logged in one lab notebook over two years, and the glacier of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Honest agents already carry what Proof of unique gene sequencing run ID asks for, so they pass without noticing; the ledge is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the nectar of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
